source: Maharashtra Government e-Gazette (Maharashtra Shasan Rajpatra Part-II, Extra-Ordinary): result notifications of each municipal corporation, issued by each Commissioner under SEC order
covers: Municipal corporations elected 15-16 Jan 2026 (29 corporations). Seen in one search (Central Section, Part-II, 16-25 Jan 2026): Brihanmumbai (Ext. 11), Thane (17), Navi Mumbai (8), Nashik (12), Kalyan-Dombivli (10), Panvel (9, 18), Vasai-Virar (16), Ulhasnagar (15), Bhiwandi-Nizampur (14), Mira-Bhayandar (13). Corporations outside the Mumbai region may be in the divisional sections. Municipal councils/nagar panchayats (elected Dec 2025): not found in one Pune-division search.
access: India only (times out from Germany; 200 from vpsin, no captcha, no login)
how_to_scrape: ASP.NET form: GET the page, POST back __VIEWSTATE etc. with ctl00$CPH$ddldivision=1 (Central) or 2-7 (divisions), ctl00$CPH$ddlSection=17 (Part-II), ctl00$CPH$ddlGazetteType=1 (Extra-Ordinary), dates DD/MM/YYYY, ctl00$CPH$btnSearch=Search; each row opens its PDF by a __doPostBack on GridView2 LinkButton1. PDFs have a text layer but Devanagari conjuncts extract broken (pdftotext); expect cleanup or OCR.

source: OpenCity Urban Data Portal (CKAN): BMC and PMC Election Results 2026 (CSV + copy of the official gazette PDF)
covers: 2 corporations: Brihanmumbai (227 wards, CSV 227 rows) and Pune (dataset pmc-election-results-2026, 4-seat panels with seat letter and reservation). No other Maharashtra corporations found on the portal.
how_to_scrape: CKAN API: https://data.opencity.in/api/3/action/package_show?id=bmc-election-results-2026 (and pmc-election-results-2026); download the resource with format CSV. License listed as public domain.

source: Kolhapur Municipal Corporation website: current house members (विद्यमान सभागृहाचे मा. सदस्य)
covers: 1 corporation: Kolhapur, 20 prabhags x 4 seats (about 81 members), elected Jan 2026.
how_to_scrape: One GET; each prabhag is a div.card with h4.card-title 'प्रभाग क्र N', each member a div.profile-card with h3.name and p.designation (seat letter). No party field.

source: Solapur Municipal Corporation website: 'नगरसेवक यादी' links to the results gazette (scanned)
how_to_scrape: Download the PDF; it has no text layer (pdftotext returns nothing), so OCR is needed. Same gazette is also in the e-Gazette (Maharashtra Shasan Rajpatra Part-II).

source: English Wikipedia per-corporation 2026 election articles, section 'Results by ward'
covers: Full ward tables seen for Brihanmumbai (227 wards: winner, party, votes, runner-up, margin), Pune (about 165 party cells) and Ahmednagar (about 68). Other 2026 articles (Nagpur, Jalna) are shorter. Not every corporation has an article.
how_to_scrape: Wikitext via https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=<article>&action=raw; parse the wikitable after '===Results by ward==='. Secondary source: use to cross-check the gazette, not as the record.

source: State Election Commission Maharashtra portal and candidate affidavit search
covers: No result documents: 'Recently Completed - Municipal Corporations' lists only ward formation, voter list and election programme orders. Candidate affidavits (all candidates, not winners) at https://mahasecelec.in/MasterSearch.aspx by local body type, division, district.
access: works from Germany (the document list page shows a captcha field for its search; the default list loads without it)
how_to_scrape: Not a councillor source. Use only to join candidate affidavits (assets, cases) to winners found in the gazette.

source: State Election Commission Gujarat: Result of Election 2026, municipal corporations (Gujarat Government Gazette Extraordinary Part IV-C, 28 Apr 2026)
covers: 15 municipal corporations (one PDF each): Ahmedabad, Bhavnagar, Gandhidham, Jamnagar, Karamsad-Anand, Mehsana, Morbi, Nadiad, Navsari, Porbandar(-Chhaya), Rajkot, Surat, Surendranagar, Vadodara, Vapi. Gandhinagar MC voted separately in Oct 2026 (result press note PDF only, legacy-font text).
access: India only (sec.gujarat.gov.in times out from Germany; 200 from vpsin)
how_to_scrape: GET the index page, take links images/<city>-corpo.pdf, fetch each from an Indian IP. PDFs (iTextSharp, 10-14 pages) have a text layer but Gujarati glyphs map wrongly (e.g. 'લ' extracts as 'િ'), so names need OCR or a glyph-fix table; sample names above are transliterated by hand.

source: State Election Commission Gujarat: Result of Election 2026, nagarpalikas (gazette Part IV-C per municipality)
covers: 31 nagarpalikas (images/pdf/<town>-np-doc.pdf): Dholka, Amreli, Umreth, Modasa, Palanpur, Bharuch, Mahuva, Botad, Bodeli, Dahod, Khambhalia, Dahegam, Veraval-Patan, Sikka, Keshod, Anjar, Kapadvanj, Kadi, Wankaner, Rajpipla, Gandevi, Godhra, Patan, Gondal, Himmatnagar, Bardoli, Limbdi, Vyara, Dabhoi, Umargam, Bhabhar. Other nagarpalikas (elected Feb 2025 or Oct 2026) not listed on this page.

sample.note: PDF dated 28 Apr 2026, 14 pages; preamble lists wards/seats won unopposed under rule 13

how_to_scrape: Same as the corporation PDFs: list links on the index page, fetch from India, OCR or glyph-fix the Gujarati text.

source: State Election Commission Gujarat: Result of Election 2021 (6 corporations + 81 nagarpalikas, district PDFs)
covers: Ahmedabad, Bhavnagar, Jamnagar, Rajkot, Surat, Vadodara (Feb 2021) and 81 nagarpalikas (images/pdf/81-NP-2021.pdf plus district files). Superseded for the corporations by 2026; kept for bodies whose 2026 result is not on the site.
how_to_scrape: Links images/pdf/Ex-IV-C-<n>-<City>-Election-Result-26-02-2021.pdf and images/pdf/<DISTRICT>-2021.pdf. MyNeta's suratMunCorpGujarat2021 (works from Germany) has the 2021 Surat winners with affidavits, also superseded.

source: Goa State Election Commission: General Election to Corporation of the City of Panaji 2026 (list of winning candidates + per-ward result sheets)
covers: 1 corporation: Panaji (CCP), 30 wards, poll 11 Mar 2026. Ward result sheets ward-1-result-sheet.pdf .. ward-30-result-sheet.pdf and result-sheet-ccp.pdf in the same folder.
access: India only (403 from Germany, 200 from vpsin)
how_to_scrape: Index page https://sec.goa.gov.in/elections/previous/corporation-of-the-city-of-panaji/general-election-to-corporation-of-city-of-panaji-2026/ lists the PDFs; text layer is clean (pdftotext -layout). No party (Goa civic polls are formally non-party).

source: Corporation of the City of Panaji website: Elected Members
covers: 1 corporation: Panaji, Mayor, Deputy Mayor and 30 councillors with postal address.

sample.name: MISS YUTIKA SHRIKANT ZAMBAULIKAR
sample.address: H NO. 427, AIVAO, NEAR SATERI TEMPLE, DONAPAULA, TISWADI

how_to_scrape: One GET (1.1 MB, windows-1252 page); the list follows the heading 'Councillors List WARD NO. NAMES OF COUNCILLORS'.

source: Goa State Election Commission: municipal council elections (2023 Ponda and Sanquelim; 2021 eleven councils; 2026 eleven councils ongoing)
covers: Ponda and Sanquelim (general election 2023: result-sheet-ponda-1.pdf, result-sheet-sanquelim.pdf, all candidates with votes). The 11 councils elected in 2021 (Bicholim, Canacona, Cuncolim, Curchorem-Cacora, Mapusa, Margao, Mormugao, Pernem, Quepem, Sanguem, Valpoi) have finished their 5-year term; their 2026 election is listed as 'ongoing' (final delimitation notice 26 Oct 2026, no poll date yet), so they probably have no elected council now. 2021 files (e.g. Bicholim-winning.pdf, Cuncolim-Result-sheet.pdf) are historical.
how_to_scrape: Result sheets list every candidate; take the top vote per ward. Watch https://sec.goa.gov.in/elections/ongoing/general-election-to-11-municipal-councils-2026/ for the 2026 results.

source: Indore Municipal Corporation website: Councillors page (Next.js, data embedded as JSON)
covers: 1 corporation: Indore, 85 wards (plus the Chairman). Updated 2026-06-15.
how_to_scrape: GET the page and read <script id=__NEXT_DATA__>: props.pageProps.data.data.attributes.details[].otherContent {title, phoneNumber, wardNumber, wardName, designation/website = address}. No party field.

source: MP State Election Commission (urban body results 2022)
covers: Should cover all 413 ULBs elected July 2022 (16 corporations, 99 nagar palika parishads, 298 nagar parishads), but the site is gone.
access: down (DNS does not resolve from Germany or India; last Wayback copy 2023-02-26; mpsec.mp.gov.in, sec.mp.gov.in also do not resolve)
how_to_scrape: Blocker. Need the SEC's current domain (ask, or find via an MP district site). By-election result notifications 2025-26 are mirrored on indianemployees.com/gazette-notifications/department/mp-state-election-commission (secondary, not official).

source: MP Urban Development portal and other corporation sites
covers: No councillor list on mpurban.gov.in (only a phone/email directory of CMO offices). mpenagarpalika.gov.in does not answer from India. Bhopal (bmconline.gov.in) is a SAP UI5 single-page app; Ujjain's parshadlist.php is 404; Jabalpur/Gwalior sites did not answer from Germany.
access: India only (mpurban.gov.in times out from Germany)
how_to_scrape: No statewide councillor source found. Remaining route: corporation sites one by one, or the MP gazette once its site is located.

source: Urban Administration & Development Dept (uad.cg.gov.in): Parshad search
covers: All ULBs in the dropdown (about 190 bodies, 33 districts; searchable by district, body, body type, party, first-meeting date). BUT the data is the 2019-20 term: Raipur rows show first meeting 06/01/2020 and the 2019 councillors, not the Feb 2025 winners. Statewide schema is good if the department updates it.
access: India only (times out from Germany), no captcha
how_to_scrape: ASP.NET form: GET, then POST hidden fields + ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$ddlNikay=<value> + ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$btnNikay=SEARCH; result is an HTML table (Raipur returned 21 rows, so check for paging). Check the first-meeting date per body to tell 2020 data from 2025 data.

source: UAD Chhattisgarh establishment portal: Election Result (mayors and chairmen, 2025)
covers: 14 municipal corporations (mayor, party, number of wards) and chairmen of nagar palika/nagar panchayats (with Excel export /export-excelmayor, /export-excelchairman). No ward councillors.
how_to_scrape: Not councillors; useful for the ward count per body and the head of each council (already saved as seeds/raw/chhattisgarh-electionresult.html).

source: Chhattisgarh State Election Commission: Nagar Palika election report 2025 (Final Nagar Palika Prativedan 2025)
covers: Report on the Feb 2025 urban body elections (173 bodies: 10 corporations, 49 nagar palika parishads, 114 nagar panchayats). 327 pages, 254 MB, CorelDRAW export: almost no text layer (Kruti Dev legacy font where present). Unknown if it lists ward winners. cgsec.gov.in otherwise has no 2025 ward result files; its result system cgsecerms.cgstate.gov.in does not answer.
access: India only (cgsec.gov.in times out from Germany)
how_to_scrape: Download from India (254 MB), render pages to images, OCR (Hindi) a few pages to see whether ward-wise winner tables are present before committing to a full OCR.
